article_context: This body image illustrates the owner’s customized zoning: a compact apartment remains visually open while the timber partition separates the sleeping and dining areas enough for two people to have distinct personal space.
image_reading: A compact open-plan apartment is divided into a sleeping area on the left and a dining area on the right by a tall slatted timber partition.
The bed, round table, chairs, windows, layered curtains, pendant lamp, and ceiling lights are visible; the curtains are the most naturally movable elements.
The partition stays central and clearly demonstrates separation without forming a full wall; the photographed interior is slightly soft and grainy.

models.positive_prompt: A gentle indoor draft slowly ripples the sheer curtains and softly stirs the heavier drapes, then eases until the curtains settle slightly parted. Fixed camera; keep the timber divider and both living zones continuously visible.
models.scene_plan: For the full five-second fixed shot, a mild draft produces moderate, continuous waves across the sheer curtain and a smaller response in the side drapes. The motion builds smoothly, then diminishes near the end, leaving the curtains slightly parted while the central divider and both functional zones remain readable.

models.positive_prompt: The sheer curtains billow gently inward as a soft draft passes across the window, with the side drapes moving only slightly. The motion gradually subsides and the curtains finish resting a little apart; the camera remains fixed on both zones and the timber divider.
models.scene_plan: Use a steady five-second view centered on the partition. A soft draft travels gradually across the layered curtains, creating a broad, slow billow in the sheer fabric and restrained movement in the heavier drapes. The airflow fades naturally in the final second, with the curtains resting a little apart and the open yet divided layout unchanged.

models.positive_prompt: With a fixed camera, a brief soft draft sends one smooth ripple through the sheer curtains while the heavier drapes sway subtly. The fabric settles slightly parted by the final frame, with the timber divider and both apartment zones still clearly visible.
models.scene_plan: In a focused four-second fixed shot, one smooth ripple moves through the sheer curtain and lightly transfers to the side drapes. The motion has a compact rise and gentle decay, ending with the curtains slightly parted while the partition, bedroom, and dining area remain continuously recognizable.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation reinforces how thoughtful zoning makes a small apartment feel open while preserving distinct personal areas.
structured_intent.primary_action: A gentle indoor draft moves the layered window curtains in one continuous flow.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The apartment remains a calm, spacious-looking home with two clearly separated functional zones.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The curtain movement subsides with the fabric resting slightly parted and both zones still clearly visible.
